uncheckedAssertion.text: This assertion panics when the value is not of type `{{type}}`, and a nil value never is. Use the comma-ok form, `typed, ok := value.({{type}})`, and say what happens when it is not, or a type switch when the value may be one of several types, so a miss has code to run instead of stopping the process.

assertionInMatchingCase.text: The type switch around this assertion already matched `{{value}}` as type `{{type}}`, so the assertion repeats what the switch knows and reads to the next person like a claim that could fail. Bind the switch, `switch typed := {{value}}.(type)`, and use `typed` here, where it already has type `{{type}}`.
